answers.value: Both acute angle and half of a right angle
answers.reasoning: A straight angle is \(180^\circ\); one-fourth of it is \(45^\circ\). Its complement is \(90^\circ - 45^\circ = 45^\circ\), which is an acute angle and also half of a right angle.
Half of a right angle is \(45^\circ\); three times it is \(135^\circ\). Its supplement is \(180^\circ - 135^\circ = 45^\circ\).

answers.value: Both A and R are true and R explains A
answers.reasoning: A regular polygon has all sides and all angles equal (R is true). A right-angled triangle has one 90° angle and two smaller ones, so its angles are not all equal; that is exactly why it is not regular. So A is true and R explains it.
The mascot of the 1982 Asian Games in Delhi was Appu, a baby elephant.
Lack of vitamin D weakens and softens the bones in children. This disease is called rickets.
When India became independent on 15 August 1947, Lord Mountbatten was its first Governor General. C. Rajagopalachari followed him in 1948 as the first (and last) Indian Governor General.
Homi Jehangir Bhabha, the father of India's nuclear programme, founded the Tata Institute of Fundamental Research in 1945 and was its first Director.
East Pakistan became the independent country of Bangladesh in 1971 after the Liberation War.
The United Nations was founded on 24 October 1945, after the Second World War.

Sita was the daughter of King Janaka of Mithila, whose capital was Janakpur. Ram won her hand there by breaking Shiva's bow.

A speedometer shows the speed of a vehicle. An odometer shows the distance travelled, and a tachometer shows how fast the engine turns.
Skateboarding is done on a board fitted with small wheels. In skating the wheels or blades are fixed to the shoes, not a board.

Chess champion Viswanathan Anand was the first sportsperson to receive the Padma Vibhushan, in 2007. Sachin Tendulkar received it a year later.
A line or chain of mountains is called a mountain range, like the Himalayan range.
Water is called the universal solvent because more substances dissolve in it than in any other liquid.
